Name: The Alchemist
Description: Nairobi's best-known creative hub — an open-air yard of shops, street-food stalls and bars with resident DJs, live sets and a courtyard crowd that spills out until the early hours.

Name: Brew Bistro & Lounge
Description: Eleventh-floor rooftop gastro pub with sweeping city views, house-brewed craft beers, cocktails and regular live-band nights that run late into the weekend.

Name: Havana Bar
Description: Long-standing Westlands Latin-inspired cocktail bar, popular for mojitos, resident DJs and a lively weekend dance floor that fills up after midnight.

Name: Gipsy Bar
Description: Casual Westlands bar with pool tables, sport screens and a friendly local crowd, open late for drinks, bar snacks and a chilled mid-week vibe.

Name: Privee
Description: Sleek VIP-focused Westlands lounge and club with bottle service, intimate booths and Afrobeats and hip-hop nights every weekend.

Name: Mercury Lounge
Description: Polished Westlands lounge for cocktails and small plates, with a dressed-up evening crowd, resident DJs and a terrace that fills up from sundowners to midnight.

Name: Sarabi Rooftop Lounge
Description: Popular rooftop lounge with sweeping city views, creative craft cocktails and DJ-led sundowners that stretch well into the night above the Westlands skyline.

Name: Tapas Bar & Restaurant
Description: Relaxed tapas bar serving Mediterranean small plates, wine and signature cocktails with a busy after-work and late-evening crowd in the heart of Westlands.

Name: Nairobi Street Kitchen
Description: Buzzy open-air food and bar yard bringing together street-food stalls, craft drinks and DJ sets in a vibrant Westlands courtyard setting, open until late.

Name: Asiatic Rooftop Bar
Description: Asian-inspired rooftop bar and restaurant open seven days a week, pairing creative cocktails with pan-Asian small plates and city views from above Westlands.

Name: Seven Seafood & Grill
Description: Premier seafood grill and bar with fresh fish flown in from the coast daily, a buzzing bar and an evening crowd that stays late for cocktails and desserts.

Name: Black Diamond
Description: Upscale Westlands club known for resident and guest DJs, a sleek modern interior, VIP sections and live band nights that pull a well-dressed late-night crowd.

Name: Cavalli Club Nairobi
Description: Glitzy Westlands nightclub with plush interiors, VIP booths and Afrobeats and amapiano nights that keep going until sunrise.

Name: Mayfair Casino
Description: One of Nairobi's longest-established casinos, offering table games, slot machines, a members' lounge and 24-hour gaming in the heart of Westlands.

Name: Casino Flamingo
Description: Spacious Westlands casino with dozens of slot machines and live gaming tables, popular with night owls looking for a late-night flutter and free parking.

Name: Kiza Restaurant & Lounge
Description: Award-winning contemporary African restaurant and lounge pairing authentic cuisine with shisha, live music and a rooftop terrace that buzzes every night.

Name: Black Samurai Lounge
Description: High-energy Kilimani club on the 6th floor, famous for themed nights, a heavyweight sound system and Afrobeats and hip-hop sets that run until dawn.

Name: XS Nairobi
Description: One of Nairobi's party powerhouses, mixing Afrobeats, amapiano and hip-hop across a big-room dance floor with regular headline DJs and themed event nights.

Name: Unseen Nairobi
Description: Rooftop bar and open-air cinema in Kilimani, pairing craft cocktails with film screenings, art pop-ups and mellow evening DJ sets above the neighbourhood.

Name: Fogo Gaucho Kilimani
Description: Brazilian steakhouse with an all-you-can-eat churrasco menu, a lively bar and an evening atmosphere that often stretches into a full night out after dinner.

Name: K1 Klub House
Description: A Nairobi nightlife institution. K1's sprawling multi-room club and beer garden keep the dance floor packed from Thursday through Sunday with Afrobeats and house.

Name: The Talisman Restaurant
Description: Elegant gastrolounge in a colonial-era building set in Karen's leafy gardens — celebrated for creative cuisine, a well-curated wine list and a relaxed evening vibe.

Name: The Purdy Arms
Description: Quintessential Karen pub and B&B — a favourite haunt with a friendly bar, hearty food, quiz nights, live sport and a garden terrace that fills at weekends.

Name: Hemingways Nairobi Bar
Description: Elegant colonial-style bar at Hemingways boutique hotel, offering handcrafted cocktails, an extensive whisky library and a refined Karen setting for a quiet evening drink.

Name: Boho Eatery
Description: Relaxed garden eatery and bar in Karen with a bohemian courtyard, brunch by day and cocktails and wine as the evening sets in, popular with a laid-back weekend crowd.

Name: The Carnivore
Description: Iconic open-air nyama choma restaurant and entertainment venue, famous for the all-you-can-eat Beast of a Feast grill, live music at Simba Saloon and late-night crowds.

Name: Sky Lounge at Ole-Sereni
Description: Rooftop lounge and grill at the Emara Ole-Sereni hotel, offering panoramic views towards Nairobi National Park, cocktails and live weekend music as the sun sets.

Name: Kengeles Lavington
Description: Neighbourhood bar and grill institution known for hearty food, cold Tusker on tap, a relaxed crowd and evenings that drift late into the night.

Name: Mambo Italia Lavington
Description: Casual Italian bar-restaurant serving artisan pizza, pasta and gelato with wine and cocktails, a lively family-friendly space that turns social in the evenings.

Name: Trademark Hotel Dining
Description: Stylish hotel bar and brasserie at the Trademark Hotel in Village Market, with cocktails, wine and refined small plates in an upmarket Gigiri setting.

Name: Village Market Dining Terrace
Description: Open-air food and entertainment terrace in the Village Market complex, with varied dining, a bar and events that draw an evening crowd from Gigiri and Runda.

Name: Radisson Blu Upper Hill Bar
Description: Chic hotel bar at the Radisson Blu Upper Hill offering creative cocktails, an international wine list and a refined business crowd on weekday evenings.

Name: Fairview Hotel Mukutan Garden
Description: 24-hour garden café and bar at the historic Fairview Hotel, with a quiet outdoor terrace, cold drinks, light bites and a peaceful Upper Hill setting open late.

Name: Kwetu Nairobi Rooftop Bar
Description: Six-venue boutique property in Upper Hill with a rooftop cocktail lounge, Mediterranean cuisine, specialty coffee and poolside drinks in a stylish hotel setting.

Name: Muthaiga Country Club
Description: Residents' bar and restaurant at the iconic Muthaiga Country Club, welcoming guests for cocktails, wines and a classic Nairobi evening in one of the city's most storied settings.

Name: Royal 58 Restaurant & Bar
Description: Contemporary restaurant and bar on Muthaiga Road offering an extensive cocktail menu, wood-fired grills and a relaxed evening terrace popular with the Muthaiga crowd.

Name: La Villa Restaurant & Wine Bar
Description: Intimate wine bar and restaurant on Riverside Drive with a curated selection of Old and New World wines, tapas and a relaxed atmosphere ideal for a quiet evening.

Name: The Bar Next Door Kileleshwa
Description: Neighbourhood bar and grill in Kileleshwa with a terrace, cold drinks, grills and a steady local crowd that keeps the evenings lively from midweek through the weekend.

Name: Hellena's Kitchen
Description: Cosy Kileleshwa restaurant and bar known for its Friday-night live band, warm atmosphere and a menu of grills and comfort food that draws a loyal local following.

Name: The Norfolk Hotel Bar
Description: Historic hotel bar at The Norfolk, one of Nairobi's most iconic addresses, offering expertly mixed cocktails, light bites and old-world charm close to the Arboretum.
